The '''17th Producers Guild of America Awards''' (also known as '''2006 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2005, were held on January 22, 2006.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=PGA on cowboy trail|url=https://variety.com/2006/film/awards/pga-on-cowboy-trail-2-1117936608/|accessdate=September 21, 2017|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|last1=Rushfield|first1=Richard|last2=Lynch|first2=Rene|title='Brokeback Mountain' Wins Producers Guild Award|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2006-jan-23-me-guild23-story.html|website=Los Angeles Times|access-date=August 27, 2017|date=January 23, Studios Hollywood|Universal]] [[Hilton Hotels|Hilton Hotel]] in [[Hollywood, California]] was hosted by [[Queen Latifah]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Queen to rule PGA's
